messages:
maya: quick handoff for Zephyr Loop — signed today, target go-live in 10d. They're on Private (VPC) with SSO and a nightly ingestion pipeline. Sales notes: ingestion fails intermittently at the dedupe stage; customer reports 20% of batches requeued. renewal signal: neutral but slips >30d and they'll push renewal pause. assigning owners below.

ryan: thanks @maya — got it. i'll own CSM rollout + enablement. can we get the ingestion failure repro + sample batch + env details? i'll plan a 30m kickoff with biz + eng.

maya: attaching minimal sample payload here (sanitized):
<sample-payload.json> {"customer_id":"zephyr-123","records":[{"id":"A1","text":"alpha"},{"id":"A1","text":"alpha duplicate"},{"id":"B2","text":"beta"}]}

lina: adding myself to triage the dedupe issue. can you confirm: model version = redwood-llama-1.2-qa, quantized=true, seq_len=2048, batch size=32? also any stack traces or run ids would help.

maya: confirmed model = redwood-llama-1.2-qa, quantized=true. infra: customer on GCP us-west1, private subnets for inference. run id from last failed job = run_2024_11_03_22:17.

sam_ops: i'll handle infra provisioning checks and VPC peering. will validate subnet CIDRs and NAT egress. ETA ~4h. cc @eng-oncall-bot if we need a faster patch.

eng-oncall-bot: created ticket SUP-4682 for ingestion/dedupe intermittent failures: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-4682 (assigned to lina).

lina: i see SUP-4682 — starting triage. first steps: 1) can you forward full logs from run_2024_11_03_22:17 (ingestion and runtime logs), 2) does customer have padding/whitespace pre-processing? that sample shows duplicates which might bypass dedupe heuristics.

maya: forwarding logs to the ticket and to @lina now. customer confirmed no custom de-dupe pre-step. they rely on our pipeline.

ryan: action items (short):
- ryan: schedule kickoff + 30m enablement (owner) — target tomorrow 10am PT
- lina: triage ticket SUP-4682, update by EOD with root-cause hypothesis
- sam_ops: validate VPC peering + infra, confirm no egress blocks (ETA 4h)
- maya: provide full logs + customer contact + trial extension request
- ops: request trial extension of +30 days if triage shows >3d fix

maya: i've asked sales to approve a 30-day extension; will confirm here once approved.

lina: quick note — if root cause is model kv-cache mismatch during continuous ingestion, fallback plan is a temporary routing to hosted variant (redwood-llama-1.2-hosted) for affected batches. need approval from customer for any fallback.

ryan: good plan. i'll prep a simple A/B fallback doc to show to product + customer.

eng-oncall-bot: support note added to SUP-4682: logs received, triage started. SLA: 72h response goal.

maya: customer kickoff attendees: CTO (Anya), Data Eng (Marco), Product Ops (Helen). they asked for a walkthrough of SSO + private deploy provisioning during kickoff.

ryan: i'll include enablement overlay (SSO checklist + reroute plan). sending calendar invite to you all — tentative tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:

lina: one last ask for now — sample of failing batch output (post-dedupe). if you can drop that into SUP-4682 i'll correlate with model logs.

maya: uploading the failing-batch.json to the ticket now.

sam_ops: infra check completed — peering ok, NAT egress open, a couple of IAM roles missing for the customer's logging bucket (added a ticket to fix).

ryan: thanks team. i'll follow up after kickoff with updated success criteria and the renewal risk flag. for now i mark renewal_risk = low-medium (slip >30d raises risk).

maya: appreciate it. keeping this thread as the single source of truth for owners.

lina: noted. SUP-4682 will have updates — ping me if you need an escalated on-call.

ryan: end-state goal: successful go-live in 10d, no data loss, enablement completed, and renewal stays on schedule.

maya: :rocket:
